meta.alignmentNote: daily series is back-adjusted; bands rescaled per session by intradayOpen/dailyOpen
meta.hDefinition: H = half the band width = (upper - lower band)/2
meta.winDefinition: net P&L per trade > 0 after the round-trip cost

dailyModel.what: predicts the session high/low band from prior daily bars

nowcast.what: given the running high/low, P(new high) and P(new low)

rules.what: entry at a band touch, exit by target/stop/close
